    <div class="um-detail-body">
      <p>Held at the American Museum of Natural History in New York, the 2025 meeting was the first in-person OpenSpace user gathering. Planetarium directors, museum educators, university researchers, and the OpenSpace development team came together for two days of workshops, presentations, and hands-on sessions — with evening events in the Hayden Planetarium and Invisible Worlds Theater.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="ds-venue-section ds-venue-section--alt" id="sessions">
  <div class="ds-venue-inner">
    <p class="ds-eyebrow">Program</p>
    <h2 class="ds-venue-title">Sessions</h2>
    <div class="um-detail-body">
      <p>The two-day program covered something for every level — from first-time users to advanced developers. Sessions ran in parallel tracks across the Davis Classrooms and Hayden Planetarium.</p>
      <ul>
        <li>Kickoff: Community, updates & what&rsquo;s ahead — Alex Bock & Megan Villa</li>
        <li>OpenSpace 101 & custom profiles workshops — Micah Acinapura</li>
        <li>Lua scripting & content import workshops — Alex Bock</li>
        <li>ShowComposer, rendered video & configuration files</li>
        <li>Multi-channel domes: CPlay and CTroll — Christian Ready, Dylan Salas</li>
        <li>Portable planetariums — Sarah Treadwell, Josh Roberts</li>
        <li>Lightning presentations from Carter Emmart, Jackie Faherty, Brian Abbott, KaChun Yu, and more</li>
        <li>Evening: planetarium shows in the Hayden and Invisible Worlds theaters</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
